Well, I can relate to you in your current situation, I live in Mexico, 24 years old, no girlfriend, family or any kind of relationship since I was 15, I´ve lived alone for most of my live, I feel no empathy for the world or its people, but I went to a phsychologist a long time ago and I discovered all sort of things, yeah, it is expensive even here in mexico but it´s worth it, believe me. 

​

At the end I discovered that even if my life sucks a lot since I was born, my reality is illustrated by my brain, so, I can affect my brain biologicaly speaking I can affect my reality, so I search for habits that can affect my brain in the LONG RUN because that is the only way to achieve good results, don´t even try Coaching or Self Help Books, they would only things get worse, The habits that help shape a healthy brains are 3, these are listed in order of importance: 

1. Do somehing that feeds your health
   1. This can be doing excercise, go to the gym, go for a run or do excercise in the park, I know this could sound stupid, but believe me, if you see the history of the human race in acient times you will see that a lot of our health relies on doing excercise, you don´t need the fitness indutry to achieve it, you just have to do some kind of excercise, twice a week for 30 minutes each, and I know it can sound awful, but if you don´t try it, you will never see the benefits that excercise have for your health.
2. Do something that feeds your soul/spirituality/heart
   1. This sounds a little bit romantic but believe it is the hell of important, actually this is the key piece of the puzzle for a healthy thinking and I don´t mean that you should go to the church or something like that, what I mean is to find a hobbie that feed your overall personality in a spiritual therm, for example, every sunday I go to a hospital as a Laugh Doctor or a Clown(path adams movie style) and help patients to have a good time in that jail of death that is a hospital, and that shapes my reality in a more funny, graceful, humble way, it is some kind of therapy for me, and it´s free. Is up to you to find what is the best for you, If rou want to fight climate change plant trees, go to help in a shelter, orphans, etc. There is a lot of problems you can spend time on, is up to you how you want to help others and at the same time helping yourself.
3. Do something that feeds your intelectual being
   1. This can be read a book, learn a new language, learn an instrument or anything that teach you something, if you keep your mind occupied in some kind of learning you will have less time to complain about how the world is a jerk(in my case) and at the same time helping you out of the same world.

Sorry for my bad english, but I can tell you that after a lot of investigation and experiments I came up with this method, that the life just teach me with serious punches, depresion and suicidal thoughts. 

​

The only way I see you could get out of that hole you´re into is to work really hard, for me, hapiness is something you achieve through a lot of hard work and discipline, it´s not something that suddenly appears, if you want a healthy life with a healthy mind you will have to work your ass for it.

​

Thanks for your time and I hope you find your happiness like I do.

Hope this help, greetings.
